note: Wikimedia Commons, “Света Злата Мегленска во црквата „Вознесение Христово“ (Св. Спас).jpg”; artist as recorded there: Tashkoskim — fetched 14 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Found by route 2: Wikidata Q2512266, labelled «Злата Мегленска» in Serbian, is the entity for this folder's stored Serbian form, and its P373 is `Category:Saint Zlata of Meglen`. The Greek «Χρυσή» and the Russian «Хриса (Хрисия, Злата) Могленская» this folder stores are the same name in the three languages — Chryse, Zlata, the golden one of Meglen — and the folder's own Russian form carries «Злата» among its three variants, so the identification does not rest on a translation. Commons describes the file as a fresco of Saint Zlata of Maglen in the church of the Ascension at Raštak near Skopje, a single named figure, 4000x6000. Kept on 13 October in the Greek and Serbian calendars and 18 October in the Russian. Commons describes it: Fresco of Saint Zlata of Maglen inside of the church "Ascension of Christ" (St. Spas) in the village Rashtak, Skopje.
